campaign_rulings.summary: Actual involuntary Frame abandonment into a Gorgon creates a genuine compulsory replacement at the next actual Off-Duty preparation, using the already approved free, Handler-defined, different-Frame package.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The source requires a functioning assigned Frame for the ordinary loop but gives no separate price for this loss case. It should not falsely become a destroyed-Frame fact or a paid optional Frame Swap.
alternatives: Require purchasing the optional Frame Swap.
Leave the original Girl permanently unable to enter the next period.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Consumers: services.m3_void.complete, services.m3_defeat_replacement. Scope: implemented_under_delegation_root_replacement_bridge. This interpretation does not enable missing consumers.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: One deterministic campaign-scoped void_frame_replacement source, no Permission charge, actual Gorgon preserved and no Girl healing/resource reset. The replacement bridge is owned by root.

campaign_rulings.summary: The original owner proposes actual completed stage-one arrival/embrace and selects the Identity to become Free; the current Handler independently confirms actual facts when existing positions differ or remain unknown.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Stage one explicitly describes making her way to and entering her Frame. An acknowledgment must not teleport a body, and a distant or unknown position must not make the printed transformation impossible to complete.
alternatives: Require already recorded same-cell positions for every transformation.
Automatically relocate the Girl without an actual arrival source.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Consumers: engine.m3_void.confirm_approach, services.m3_void.VoidService.respond, discord_adapter.m3_void.open_void. Scope: implemented_under_delegation. This interpretation does not enable missing consumers.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Exact original body/Frame and current state are frozen; intervening changes require reproposal. Actual known Frame position becomes the entered body position, or coordinates remain unknown. No new vessel, healing or ordinary travel command is created.

campaign_rulings.summary: Actual protection requires the original request and a separate response through the controlled actual guardian role. Only that role controller releases its still-active hold. An actual guardian career end interrupts its source-created hold without moving or healing the protected body.
campaign_rulings.rationale: A mere acknowledgment is not physical prevention; lasting custody needs an actionable way to end and must not become inherited authority for the guardian controller’s next character.
alternatives: Count a player acknowledgment as prevention without a physical consequence.
Create an indefinite hold with no owned release or ending cleanup.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Consumers: engine.m3_void.prevent_entry, engine.m3_physical.release_protective_hold, engine.m3_physical.interrupt_protective_holds, engine.m3_physical.interrupt_journeys, services.m3_void.VoidService.respond. Scope: implemented_under_delegation. This interpretation does not enable missing consumers.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Shared actual cast/immutable legacy-cast evidence is required; known separated cells cannot become co-location, and unknown positions stay unguessed. Resolved-source card remains in the inbox while the hold is active. Girl allure persists, so later actual own-Frame entry re-triggers. Actual NPC/Harpy death consumers must invoke the exported interruption helper.

campaign_rulings.summary: At birth replace the selected actual Identity label with Free, preserving real marks/locks. At rebirth retain only the old resources the owner chooses, then add the additional distinct Free from Harpy starting rules.
campaign_rulings.rationale: PDF179 replacement/erasure and PDF181 additional-Free starting text are not fully aligned. This is a literal two-stage reconciliation, not an unambiguous printed result.
alternatives: Coalesce a retained Free into one additional non-ordinary Identity.
Use only PDF179 and make no additional Free compulsory.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Consumers: engine.m3_void.begin_questions, engine.m3_void.confirm_approach, engine.m3_void.rebirth, engine.m3_void_state.HarpyIdentity. Scope: implemented_under_delegation_requires_clarity. This interpretation does not enable missing consumers.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: A retained birth-Free and the final additional Free may have the same label but distinct IDs. Harpy Identities have no ordinary four-slot cap. This affects the available pool of markable Identities and must be easy to revise.

campaign_rulings.summary: A former PC Harpy retains the original fictional person’s Bonds except those the original owner actually discards during rebirth; preserve exact counterpart ActorRefs and rebind the same person to the actual new Harpy body.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The explicit permission to discard unwanted Bonds and the former-PC retention rule can coexist. Human account IDs and a successor Girl are not the same fictional endpoints.
alternatives: Erase every former PC Bond at conversion.
Copy numeric account edges onto a replacement Girl.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Consumers: engine.m3_void.rebirth, engine.m3_actor_bonds.migrate_actor, engine.m3_actor_bonds.rebind. Scope: implemented_source_reconciliation. This interpretation does not enable missing consumers.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: One canonical ActorRef graph, no duplicate numeric authority, no inheritance by a new Pilot incarnation. Original Harpy retains independent Heat/resources and controller.

campaign_rulings.summary: Any honest yes leads to actual consumption/overgrowth. The actual Handler records uncertain survival as a real factual outcome; neither death nor survival is silently assumed.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The text explicitly says likely but not certainly dies, without a roll or numeric procedure.
alternatives: Always kill the Girl automatically.
Always grant survival automatically.
Invent an unsupported survival roll.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Consumers: engine.m3_void.answer_question, engine.m3_void.overgrown_fate, services.m3_void.VoidService.respond. Scope: implemented_under_delegation. This interpretation does not enable missing consumers.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: A living original Girl remains the same injured/incapacitated body inside the actual Gorgon Frame and in its custody; no reborn Harpy, extraction, healing or medical help is invented. Actual death archives the original. Future real rescue/medical recovery remains required.

campaign_rulings.summary: Current corrupt reducer emits Mockingbird resistance only when she is actually in her own Frame with all Frame Assets Void. Outside, no autonomous Frame-Gorgon work is emitted; real later entry creates source-backed resistance.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Risk Factor explicitly restricts when the Girl succumbs, but whether that also postpones autonomous Frame transformation is unclear. Do not describe the current behavior as unambiguous source text.
alternatives: Apply autonomous Frame-to-Gorgon outside while preserving the Girl’s Risk Factor immunity.
Apply the exception to both Girl and Frame until actual entry, matching current code.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Consumers: engine.m3_core.corrupt, engine.m3_void.start_threshold, services.m3_physical.PhysicalService.operate. Scope: current_behavior_ambiguity_review_not_new_implementation_claim. This interpretation does not enable missing consumers.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Changing this choice changes the availability of the original Frame before re-entry and requires a real Frame transformation consumer/test, not merely a documentation or policy flag.

campaign_rulings.summary: Actual Handler death ends the fictional body; the same appointed human continues OOC adjudication and may create a fresh persona.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF15 / printed13; Handler body/context continuation is a delegated campaign implementation interpretation
campaign_rulings.rationale: Fictional death must retain its resource consequences without stranding mandatory human decisions.
alternatives: End the human appointment or treat the dead body as alive.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Archive exact body, Tags, Heat, Bonds and source links. Remove its fictional cast role. Freeze actual human GM and appointment separately from the optional historical body; no fictional ability, consent or Bond/Status bonus follows from OOC authority.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Review pending original-body decisions; retain actual deaths and human decisions.

campaign_rulings.summary: After any Handler body archive, fresh creation uses a new generation and fresh owned starting choices, with no predecessor resources, authority or consent.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF15 / printed13; Handler body/context continuation is a delegated campaign implementation interpretation
campaign_rulings.rationale: A Discord account is not the fictional person; first legacy adoption names the existing same body only.
alternatives: Reuse old persona forms/resources or forbid replacement entirely.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Allow initial legacy adoption only before any archive. Derive subsequent generation from the real ending event; stale drafts/forms/agreements cannot activate. NPCs remain distinct controlled people, not inherited Handler abilities.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: A different baseline needs explicit future policy and migration; never transfer historical personal rights silently.

campaign_rulings.summary: Handler death suspends the original Director-presence context and source-proved old-body reviews without NPC departure or departure rewards.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF15 / printed13; Handler body/context continuation is a delegated campaign implementation interpretation
campaign_rulings.rationale: The dead body cannot continue Girl-rule Identity use, while death does not prove the Director left.
alternatives: Run ordinary departure effects or transfer the old context to a fresh persona.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Archive the original context. Preserve actual Director and Identity records; set inactive with actual death termination event and revision. Close only reviews proven to concern the original body. A new persona requires a fresh actual context.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Preserve original presence and nondeparture proof; apply future recovery changes prospectively.

campaign_rulings.summary: Other pending damage/Helpless replacement requests for an actually dead original Handler end by that death source, without another fabricated selection or successor inheritance.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF15 / printed13; Handler body/context continuation is a delegated campaign implementation interpretation
campaign_rulings.rationale: An already-dead original cannot choose a live-body replacement effect; pending sources must preserve actual ownership.
alternatives: Leave requests permanently pending, assign them to a successor, or manufacture another death choice.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Preserve each frozen trigger/opponent/action/work/request. The chosen request records death; other same-body requests record ended and actual ending consequence/event, with no invented choice. Only registered exact source callbacks can finish; unsupported producers fail closed.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Retain individual original source events and actual death; review future overlapping-trigger policy explicitly.

campaign_rulings.summary: On Go For the Core 11+, anyone else means non-NPC target categories, not automatic bystander damage. Every target may choose its owned counter, including a dying NPC; an explicit decline is permitted by may.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF26 / printed24; NPC distinction PDF5; delegated literal interpretation
campaign_rulings.rationale: The paragraph contrasts the target being an NPC with other target categories. Applying automatic damage to every bystander invents effects. The preceding target counter permission is not expressly removed for NPCs; may permits an actual owned decline.
alternatives: Damage every bystander automatically and omit the NPC counter.
Require a target counter even when its original controller explicitly declines.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: High: actual NPC explosive death; non-NPC target damages an actual undamaged Asset or dies. Both retain an actual optional zero-or-one counter; low permits explicit decline or one-to-two counters and actual NPC defense/death proof. Never infer decline from absence or grant another role the choice. Default Handler gear descriptions create no Assets: no real undamaged Asset means death. Only source-proved actual transferred mechanical items may supply an Asset consumer; no proxy sheet or HP slots.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: The earlier unimplemented foundation plan was corrected. Actual battle consumers and golden traces must use this scope; preserve known outcomes and review any future source clarification before changing pending counters.

campaign_rulings.summary: A Tag deliberately authored by the actual human GM uses that original human and frozen authenticated appointment as setter, independently of any fictional Handler body. No future persona gains this authorship.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF115 / printed p.113 (GM responsibility while not actively playing the Handler character); PDF117 / printed p.115 (Mess with Status, Tags or Assets); PDF11 / printed p.9 (Tags); delegated digital source-ownership interpretation
campaign_rulings.rationale: The ordinary Handler Play remains a human GM procedure when the GM has no fictional Handler body. Assigning its Tag to the giver UID current persona would fabricate a body or transfer authorship after replacement. The original human owns their actual authored choice; fictional setter Tags remain source-ActorRef-bound.
alternatives: Require an actual Handler body for the ordinary GM procedure.
Treat the current persona as original setter by matching account UID.
Allow an arbitrary appointment string to assert OOC ownership.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: New OOC Tags require actual Game event actor matching authenticated GM appointment and record gm_setter_appointment plus actual gm_setter_event. The source-proof helper validates actual creation history, original target CID/body/context, unchanged original Tag principal, actual appointment at creation, and absence before creation. First persona adoption and body-ending stamps skip OOC Tags. Such a human Tag does not qualify for character-specific Mentor exceptions. Preserve these fields across actual Void conversion without fabricating an ActorRef.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Do not relabel existing fictional Tags or infer OOC authorship from a missing legacy ActorRef. Historical Tags need actual original source proof; changing principal requires explicit source review and cannot transfer old consent to a new persona.

campaign_rulings.summary: Count only actual undamaged Assets belonging to the target and physically present with that targeted body: outside or unlinked Girl/Harpy Girl Assets only; own linked Frame includes its Frame Assets; passenger excludes assigned parked Frame and carrier resources; real mechanical held objects retain source identity.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Remote or another person’s resources cannot provide invisible armour or be damaged through the wrong body.
alternatives: Literal all owned Assets including remote parked Frames
Count carrier armour as passenger resources
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Outside/passenger Core modifier changes; actual carrier Core exposure remains required; no body travel, resource reassignment or controller alias.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Outside/passenger Core modifier changes; actual carrier Core exposure remains required; no body travel, resource reassignment or controller alias. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: Freeze the high result fixed damage/death predicate and eligible original Asset IDs when the counter window opens; perform actual counter effects before payment; a newly evolved/repaired additional Asset or closed Core cannot negate an already required death or pay with a newly created Asset.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Keeps counter ownership and last actions real while preserving the printed fixed strike cost and original actual target.
alternatives: Recompute after every counter effect, allowing new survival resources
Apply death before counters and infer archived ordinary abilities
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Deferred real original-body effects; no new-body damage or duplicate death if original ended during its own counter; original controller can explicitly decline optional counters.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Deferred real original-body effects; no new-body damage or duplicate death if original ended during its own counter; original controller can explicitly decline optional counters. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: Description-only Handler gear grants no numerical Assets or HP. Only a proved actual mechanical HeldItem supplies an Asset. A baseline Handler has Core modifier zero and the printed direct death on mid or high without actual undamaged Assets; actual would-damage or Helpless uses its owned replacement choice.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The source gives gear access and a replacement table, not a hidden numeric sheet.
alternatives: Infer one Asset for each named weapon or outfit
Always replace decisive death with an injury choice
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: No invented HP; no Handler injury escape from explicit decisive death. Girl-rules context actual object damage is a separate body resource port.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: No invented HP; no Handler injury escape from explicit decisive death. Girl-rules context actual object damage is a separate body resource port. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: The Director remains its actual NPC identity but consumes Handler-rule damage/Helpless replacement choices. Real death ends only that body, cast role and affected presence; actual other living participating Directors preserve the Handler’s context. A required new Director has a new ID and a real separately accepted human role.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The explicit Director rule overrides ordinary NPC mechanics; his controller is not silently the appointed GM or another person’s Handler body.
alternatives: Ordinary NPC replacement/explosion mechanics
Alias Director to main Handler resources
Automatically spawn an unaccepted replacement
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Dedicated actual-body consequences and source-proved administrative replacement, no fictitious departure, Heat reset or free Identities. Current context body_actor retains stable physical identity through rule changes.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Dedicated actual-body consequences and source-proved administrative replacement, no fictitious departure, Heat reset or free Identities. Current context body_actor retains stable physical identity through rule changes. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: An ordinary NPC low-result defence must be an actual held object, recorded capability Tag, or real protective location already present in canonical history before the attack declaration, with the GM confirming its actual relevance before dice.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The book allows a way to defend oneself but does not give NPCs automatic immunity or an after-result invented shield.
alternatives: Assume every guard is immune
Create a defence after learning a failed strike
Never permit NPC defence
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: No invented stats; actual owner still chooses optional counters. Real defence does not prevent the fixed high-result NPC death.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: No invented stats; actual owner still chooses optional counters. Real defence does not prevent the fixed high-result NPC death. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: An NPC may perform an exact owned job-defined Conversation move as its counter, with its actual action recorded against the original attacker. The implemented narrative move subset creates no invented HP, player replies or general GM authority.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The NPC chapter explicitly describes these Plays as Conversation guidelines, rather than another dice system.
alternatives: Replace NPC Play with GM Play
Treat any handled acknowledgement as completion
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Safe source moves are available for most jobs; mechanical job moves and full job playbooks remain separately scoped and are not claimed complete.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Safe source moves are available for most jobs; mechanical job moves and full job playbooks remain separately scoped and are not claimed complete. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: The actual campaign GM records factual pre-roll opening/reach review and procedural table input. When a Director is present in the actual scene, an explicit self-owned cast adjudicator must be selected; its actual controller owns frozen Battle result and forced Handler-rule choices for this episode.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Separates OOC campaign administration from fictional/printed Director authority without moving another body or giving global GM permission.
alternatives: Let the main Handler choose despite Girl-rules mode
Automatically appoint a Director without a real source choice
Treat the Director controller as a new global GM
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Context freezes actual Director ActorRef/controller and signed role selection; original episode authority survives source completion, and new bodies/other characters gain no general permission.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Context freezes actual Director ActorRef/controller and signed role selection; original episode authority survives source completion, and new bodies/other characters gain no general permission. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: Go For the Core still requires a real owned mechanical Asset. A damaged Asset may be declared only when actual pre-roll Conversation explicitly confirms that this damaged Asset can perform the strike; ordinary objects or invented body capability do not create Assets.
campaign_rulings.rationale: PDF26 explicitly requires saying what Asset is used; PDF15 permits fighting with Plays but conditions Conversation use on an undamaged Asset. The damaged-Play eligibility needs clarity rather than a fabricated zero-Asset exception.

Allow every damaged Asset automatically
Allow nonmechanical gear or a zero-Asset body strike

campaign_rulings.summary: Freeze whether the actual taking hold used the Girl body or her piloted original Frame; reject known contradictory contact positions and leave unknown cells unknown.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF79 / printed77; physical context PDF113 / printed111
campaign_rulings.rationale: The trigger does not impose a universal piloting-only requirement or supply teleportation. Earned grip belongs to its actual physical source; losing a Frame ends a Frame-contact grip, while the same living original Girl can always release a body grip.
alternatives: Restrict all such grips to piloting without a printed restriction.
Treat all grips as persistent after the actual holding Frame is destroyed.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Original holder release is pause-safe and does not move anybody or cure separate Helplessness. Optional Frame Swap, reserve and Retirement block outstanding grips. Actual compulsory loss/replacement does not transfer grip to a new Frame.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Review historical Grasp.contact sources before changing classification; never invent a retroactive physical position.

campaign_rulings.summary: A non-Dog Enforcer may offer to carry out a real pending Punishment; the original chooser accepts an actual executor while retaining the debt and instruction ownership.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF78 / printed76; Punishments PDF17–18 / printed15–16
campaign_rulings.rationale: Volunteering is an offer rather than an automatic reassignment or fulfillment. This keeps the printed inflictor resources/Bonds attributed to the actual executor and preserves the original source obligation.
alternatives: Automatically transfer the original selection ownership to the volunteer.
Treat offering as completion of the Punishment.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Decline/withdraw closes only optional offers. Actual on-screen participation, actual type/details, Handler consultation where needed, actual effects and immediate followups remain required. Unsupported severe/delegated surgery execution is unavailable, never represented by proxy authority.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Outstanding offers retain original ActorRefs and source work. Do not reopen fulfilled debt or transfer an old incarnation to its successor.

campaign_rulings.summary: If an actual printed Handler replacement or source-bound Void outcome ends an original participant before later Initiative clauses can occur, record the actual ending and explicitly unperformed clauses; do not punish or question a replacement body.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The printed rules do not explain this overlap. An actual death/conversion cannot manufacture the original on-screen scene or silently grant an entitlement over a new person.
alternatives: Require a fabricated acknowledgment of impossible old-body scenes.
Transfer the old consequences automatically to a new character/persona.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Only actual source-event archives/final Void outcomes authorize closure. Known rolls are retained; no refund, reroll, fake response, new persona or invented Punishment is produced.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Audit completed original-source closures separately from fulfilled Punishments. This interpretation explicitly requires printed-rule clarity review.

campaign_rulings.summary: Girl Asset ownership alone does not classify a body part or trait as a takeable object. Use printed pistol/Gun sources or actual holder-and-Handler proof of an existing carried object, optionally bound to an unchanged actual Girl Asset.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Taking something from a person must have a real object source. A descriptive possession is not a newly granted mechanical Asset, while an existing physical Asset retains its real source and mechanical identity.
alternatives: Offer every Girl Asset, including body parts/traits, as loot.
Grant fresh Asset statistics to every story possession.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Factual confirmation records no new slots/stats and cannot detach mounted Frame equipment or body parts. Current custody and immutable original ownership remain necessary. Weapon-on-hand is an actual printed or confirmed factual property, not inferred from arbitrary names.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Historical object bindings must preserve source ActorRefs/Asset IDs; do not duplicate an object when its original Asset is restored or a new incarnation appears.

campaign_rulings.summary: A qualifying lost-pistol return is a Foundation-issued replacement physical pistol with a distinct identity, under the same original paid grant and qualifying event.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF79 / printed77; owner delegated recommendation adopted by root
campaign_rulings.rationale: The source permits getting the lost pistol back without specifying retrieval when its original is in another actual person's custody. A distinct Foundation issue preserves truthful physical custody and source-bound eligibility.
alternatives: Require actual retrieval and custody transfer of the stolen original.
Teleport a stolen original away from its current real holder.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Record original recipient ActorRef, actual human controller, prior lost Asset ID, actual grant/roll/event and replacement mode. Never duplicate one physical ID or alter the stolen original's custody. Later recovery is a separate real inventory transfer with normal capacity.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Audit distinct existing issue IDs/custody before changing the interpretation. No extra ability, Permission currency or unlimited Asset slots is granted. New rulings do not retroactively move original objects.

campaign_rulings.summary: A Tag explicitly retained by the same fictional person through actual Harpy rebirth retains its original Beneath rejection restriction. Only the original locker (including its proved same-person Harpy conversion) grants consent; Tag giver and replacement characters gain no consent authority.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF22 / printed20; PDF179,181 / printed177,179; delegated source reconciliation
campaign_rulings.rationale: Retaining the same Tag does not explicitly revoke its printed lock. Rebirth preserves a fictional person while changing actual actor representation; immutable conversion/retention and original source proof prevent account aliases from changing choice ownership.
alternatives: Remove every Beneath restriction at Harpy conversion.
Copy old UID consent authority onto replacement Girls.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Pure engine.m3_tag_permissions verifies actual selected retained IDs and original obligations. PermissionService verifies genuine immutable original effect/real birth/explicit locker command before actual ActorPlay rejection. Marker is recorded only on newly created career archive before first history; no past archive rewriting. Scope: implemented_source_reconciliation; no source review certification.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Changing this interpretation affects currently pending retained-Tag consent; append a sourceful adjustment rather than silently rewriting prior grants, birth history or discarded Tags.

campaign_rulings.summary: The actual Harpy controller voices the actual retained Frame for source extraction permission and opening.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Harpy combines her Girl/Frame; no separate GM/NPC Frame voice is supplied. Requires actual source-bound Harpy/Frame identity.
alternatives: Require an independently assigned Frame voice, creating an unprinted control assignment.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: No GM permission substitutes; revocation and later positive consent remain explicit actual owned responses.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: No GM permission substitutes; revocation and later positive consent remain explicit actual owned responses. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: If every actual Harpy Asset is already Void, explicitly record the actual inflicted Void state with no resource alteration or new Asset; still perform actual forced Dive if source close. If an uncorrupted Asset exists it must be selected and altered.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Gain Void normally rewrites an uncorrupted Asset; an already transformed fully Void Harpy cannot gain a fabricated Asset or repeat conversion.
alternatives: Block resolution indefinitely or create an additional Void Asset without source authority.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: No free Asset, healing or repeated transformation. Source cost is auditable; forced Dive remains required.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: No free Asset, healing or repeated transformation. Source cost is auditable; forced Dive remains required. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: Real extraction with actual Frame consent unlinks the actual Harpy body at the Frame current cell, preserving unknown positions and inactive vital signs. Real medical help must separately establish recovery.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Dive states inactive vital signs and consent gate; neither permission nor physical removal says to heal, transport or revive.
alternatives: Treat extraction as automatic waking and relocation.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Owner/help proposals and actual GM factual review preserve resources, locations, source locks and audit. Subsumption alone does not prohibit Frame control.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Owner/help proposals and actual GM factual review preserve resources, locations, source locks and audit. Subsumption alone does not prohibit Frame control. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: After an actual original-owner return, issue new source-bound pending work rather than reopening a closed original career receipt. A replacement character inherits none of it.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF16-18,29 and181; delegated digital original-character restoration interpretation
campaign_rulings.rationale: Printed obligations and replacement consequences attach to their actual original character. A recorded career ending closes historical work; restoring that person must not erase the still-unfulfilled cause or mutate old receipts.
alternatives: Reopen and mutate the original closed work.
Discard every unfulfilled cause on return.
Assign the old cause to the same human account's new character.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Authenticate original closure/archive and latest actual return against immutable history. Reissue only the relevant unfulfilled source family in a new actual period, preserve original character IDs and suppress fulfilled or already-pending descendants.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Review outstanding returned-original work before changing timing. Keep fulfilled outcomes, closed receipts, actual return records and successor resources intact.

campaign_rulings.summary: An outstanding original mission cause that survives a genuine return is handled in the first eligible actual Off-Duty period after that mission completes. The same mission failure and Dog cause share one actual Punishment; a separate Defeat cause remains separate.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF16-18 and29; explicit owner failure/Dog overlap decision plus delegated post-return timing
campaign_rulings.rationale: An absent original person cannot receive a staged Punishment through their replacement. Original mission obligations still need a real on-screen resolution once that same person returns; this supplies timing without inventing a second punishment for the owner-approved failure/Dog overlap.
alternatives: Reopen the completed original mission.
Require discipline before the original has actually returned.
Forgive unfinished causes when a career is interrupted.
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Preserve the first actual mission cause, immutable completed mission and original CID. Bind new actual period work only after source-authenticated return; actual punishment and owned screen attestations settle the debt, with failure/Dog bundled only for that same mission and return.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Changing timing requires reviewing pending return work. Never repeat completed Punishments, merge a distinct Defeat debt into failure/Dog, or transfer an old cause to a successor.

campaign_rulings.summary: An actual same-person Harpy retains the original surgery's forbidden Defeat. Its mandatory source opens an explicit owned human adjudication of the whole pre-Tag integer total, without dice, faces, Heat spending or automatic modifier addition. Actual normal Tag and outcome decisions follow.
campaign_rulings.rationale: A same-person transformation does not erase an actual completed surgery. A mandatory consequence still needs a real owned outcome, so the existing clearly labelled no-roll adjudication applies without restoring the forbidden Play.
alternatives: Ignore the source surgery and roll
Leave the mandatory consequence permanently blocked
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Extends the existing delegated mandatory no-roll ruling; does not restore an ability or supply a favorable result.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Extends the existing delegated mandatory no-roll ruling; does not restore an ability or supply a favorable result. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: The defeated Harpy's original controller selects another actual scene Harpy for the printed rescue. Move the actual accessible surviving bodies to unknown offstage positions without manufacturing the rescuer's human answer or dialogue. Real custody, subsumption and extraction gates still apply.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The printed result grants rescue by an actual Harpy already in the scene, without adding a separate veto or an invented rescuer. Keep the hard result distinct from human-authored dialogue and from physical extraction gates.
alternatives: Add a rescuer veto not stated by this result
Invent another Harpy or a rescue reply
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Preserves the printed hard effect and distinct actors/resources.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Preserves the printed hard effect and distinct actors/resources. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: Printed escape places each actual traveling body and accompanying occupied vessel offstage with unknown position, preserving resources, custody distinctions and parked Frames. Rift following needs an original-controller factual navigation proposal and explicit source adjudicator review. A return needs its actual destination and actual reviewed navigation, without automatic healing or relocation to base.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Escape establishes leaving the present situation, not an arbitrary map destination. Navigation and return therefore require actual original-controller facts and a real adjudicator review while maintaining unknown positions.
alternatives: Assign an arbitrary map destination
Grant navigation from the Rift alone
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: A typed overlay handles World bodies whose base map cell cannot represent unknown; no second Asset pool exists.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: A typed overlay handles World bodies whose base map cell cannot represent unknown; no second Asset pool exists. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: Only the actual original Girl answers the plea. Refusal applies her actual Status increase and her chosen Tag. Acceptance preserves her currently piloted own Frame when it actually accompanies her; an outside body leaves its assigned parked Frame in place. Occupying another vessel or actual subsumption requires the existing real extraction/consent path. Accompaniment is not kidnapping custody.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The printed offer gives the affected Girl her own reply. Travelling in her currently piloted own Frame preserves her existing embodiment; nothing permits commandeering another person's vessel or bypassing extraction.
alternatives: Force every accepting Girl to abandon her Frame
Move somebody else's occupied Frame without authority
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: The actual owned reply controls the outcome and does not spend, heal or inherit resources.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: The actual owned reply controls the outcome and does not spend, heal or inherit resources. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: Use the original damage source's actual opponent as killer where available. Otherwise the actual source adjudicator records the factual original killer. Shutdown/capture records an actual present Foundation captor, preserves unknowns and existing custody/consent gates, and never spawns a proxy NPC or fabricates transport.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Consequences refer to the actual original killer or captor. A replacement character, willingness to surrender, or a missing fictional person cannot establish historical identity or physical custody.
alternatives: Treat the chooser's current replacement as killer
Turn willingness to surrender into invented physical access
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: The death Tag and custody remain bound to actual original ActorRefs.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: The death Tag and custody remain bound to actual original ActorRefs. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: Severing the link completes the Defeat roll and its damage-source work while preserving a standing exact-original requirement to fight until actual typed Helplessness. This lets genuine combat continue after chat restoration; acknowledgement cannot satisfy it, and voluntary escape/navigation remains blocked while required.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The printed obligation requires later combat, which cannot occur if the completed Defeat retains the same chat lock indefinitely. A durable exact-original effect preserves the obligation without inventing Helplessness.
alternatives: Hold the roll's chat lock forever while requiring later combat
Mark the Harpy Helpless automatically
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Uses a durable source effect and an actual-condition finish operation. Original ending before Helpless needs the source-ended closure integration listed below.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Uses a durable source effect and an actual-condition finish operation. Original ending before Helpless needs the source-ended closure integration listed below. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: The lasting Rift remains open until its original Harpy controller explicitly closes that source effect; closure does not return, heal or move bodies already offstage. The source-owned closure procedure does not grant a successor any fictional authority.
campaign_rulings.rationale: A lasting Rift has its own printed owned closure choice. Keeping that original effect procedure distinct from a new body action prevents timers, staff acknowledgement, and replacements from choosing for its owner.
alternatives: Automatically close on a timer or body death
Leave a lasting effect without its printed owner control
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: An owned lasting-effect procedure remains distinct from creating a new body action.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: An owned lasting-effect procedure remains distinct from creating a new body action. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: A real original human may finish an already-owned source procedural question after the actual Director body ends. Require immutable original cast/Director-death/episode proof. No new fictional body effects, unrelated questions or global GM authority are granted. A required Battle GM Play uses its frozen human scene-judge principal separately from the actual campaign appointment.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Fictional body death does not erase an already-assigned human procedure. Actual immutable episode/death proof preserves only that finite source scope; global GM authority and a dead NPC's body effects do not follow.
alternatives: Transfer the pending ruling to an unrelated human or new body
Deadlock the already-owned procedural question
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Source-scoped OOC Tags carry an authenticated finite HandlerPlay grant, the actual campaign appointment, and actual creation event; retained same-person Tags preserve this source.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Source-scoped OOC Tags carry an authenticated finite HandlerPlay grant, the actual campaign appointment, and actual creation event; retained same-person Tags preserve this source. Review pending source work before revision; preserve original receipts and immutable history.

campaign_rulings.summary: The Harpy may take one additional distinct Engage option at any Engage or All Out Assault tier. In Assault it is selected before primary consequences, uses an actual owned usable Asset, adds no separate roll and does not introduce Engage tier damage.

alternatives: Only permit the extra at successful tiers
Resolve a second Engage roll or add its damage to Assault
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Optional owned native response precedes the actual Assault result; no primary consequences are waived. Requires printed-rule clarity review.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Changes exact maneuver count/timing for pending Harpy actions; preserve original source receipts and resolve pending choices before changing.

campaign_rulings.summary: Engage records each selected maneuver, real actor/opponent/Asset, actual human-authored resulting circumstances and immutable source event. It does not assign an unchosen map cell or invent numeric armour/damage.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The printed options describe battlefield position and circumstances in the Conversation rather than a coordinate or HP procedure.
alternatives: Automatically choose a grid destination
Treat a mere handled acknowledgment as a maneuver effect
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Typed canonical Maneuver facts retain exact effects for source review and subsequent Conversation judgments. Actual Asset damage still uses the sole damage/Defeat port. Requires printed-rule clarity review.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Any future automated position consumer must require actual player-chosen source facts; preserve historical maneuver records.

campaign_rulings.summary: Removing an observed actual Cadre Handler Tag is diceless and may occur during another held Play. Favour asks the original Handler without an automatic reward; Compel lets that original human choose pausing for control or acting on the Tag. Attention is recorded directly.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The printed alternatives specify direct attention, optional favours and two Handler responses. They do not grant dice, automatic resources or a new Handler Play.
alternatives: Infer a favour grant or mechanical reward from the request
Automatically choose the Handler's action
Forbid all Tag uses while a scene is held
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Actual source-bound requests and original-human native replies; attention produces an original-controller private Inbox notice with only a technical read receipt, no fictional answer or required mechanical work. Saved private receipts remain readable under unavailable rules; new gameplay remains strictly gated. Safety pause blocks mechanical mutations. Requires printed-rule clarity review.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Preserve consumed Tag receipts and pending original-body ownership when revising.

campaign_rulings.summary: Spending a Handler Tag invalidates only uncommitted proposals that relied on it, returning those choices to their original humans without rerolling. An already committed modifier remains; a repeated-Tag decision for the now removed Tag closes without inventing an Identity or rejection action.
campaign_rulings.source: Rulebook PDF11 / printed9: other-player Tag window and Handler Tag removal at any time
campaign_rulings.rationale: Both source rules must coexist. A consumed Tag cannot remain newly selectable, but consumption does not refund or replace a modifier already committed by an actual earlier event.
alternatives: Disallow removal while any Play is held
Keep an uncommitted removed Tag as an active resource
Undo a committed modifier or invent a required replacement Identity
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Only exact actual Handler body and Tag IDs are matched; known receipts and unrelated human choices remain. Requires printed-rule clarity review.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Pending Tag windows and repeated-Tag decisions need source-aware reconciliation before changing timing.

campaign_rulings.summary: The private picker exposes only observed Handler Tags. The original Girl supplies the factual request. If the exact original Handler role subsequently ends, its former human may close only that request against a proved original ending; a successor gains no obligation or fictional action.
campaign_rulings.source: Rulebook PDF11 / printed9; existing original-person lifecycle rules
campaign_rulings.rationale: A private selector must not reveal unobserved content or transfer an old request through a human account to a new character.
alternatives: Show every private Tag to any account
Let a successor answer as the old Handler
Leave the original request impossible to resolve after a proved ending
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Original ActorRefs, immutable source history and actual ending proof are required. This does not add M4 fictional-knowledge automation. Requires printed-rule clarity review.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: A different visibility or post-ending policy needs migration of pending source requests; retain immutable consumed Tag records.

campaign_rulings.summary: A real Director uses Handler Tag rules on that Director's own world Tag record and controlled body. This never spends the Cadre Handler's Tags or lets the OOC GM answer for the Director. Temporary Girl roll rules do not transfer the original Cadre Handler's Tag ownership to the Director.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The Director explicitly uses Handler rules. Actual target/controller references keep this distinct from the Cadre Handler and its temporary rules context.
alternatives: Allow Tag use only on the Cadre Handler
Treat every NPC Handler job as a Director
Use the campaign GM account as every Director's controller
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Known present Director selector uses its sole world Tag authority; original controller owns any reply. A favour agreement gives no automatic help or free mechanical benefit; actual Director help still needs its separate price system. Requires printed-rule clarity review.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Preserve exact NPC IDs and source-human audience; never reassign pending requests to successor Directors.

campaign_rulings.summary: An actual Dormant-required Dive forbidden by completed original surgery uses existing source-specific honest manual adjudication. Original appointed or selected scene judge human assigns whole integer pre-Tag total with reason; no RNG/faces/Heat/Identity spend, then normal actual Tag and outcome owners. Inherited prohibition remains after actual rebirth.
campaign_rulings.source: official private rulebook PDF24 / printed22; official private rulebook PDF165 / printed163; official private rulebook PDF196 / printed194
campaign_rulings.rationale: The required Dormant Dive and a completed surgery prohibition can both apply, but the book supplies no exception for the resulting compulsory impossible roll. An owned explicit no-roll decision resolves that conflict without inventing ability restoration or dice.
alternatives: Deadlock the compulsory source permanently
Invent ability restoration or an automatic favorable result
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Required(dormant_dive_work) authenticates original body/controller, exact work revision, original surgery and source judge; AdjudicationService writes honest faces:null receipt then normal owned Tag/Dive pipeline.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Only actual pending Dormant source work and exact original actor/controller; voluntary forbidden Dive remains unavailable.

campaign_rulings.summary: Retain one real 2d6 roll with base modifier zero because Harpies have no ranked Status; no Heat/Identity gain or spending. All tiers use the printed Harpy hide and recovery replacement, followed by actual owner choices and factual navigation review.
campaign_rulings.rationale: Harpy Off-Duty explicitly replaces scenes, whereas the adjacent Sensor exception explicitly replaces rolling. Harpies have no Cadre Status value, leaving the ordinary roll modifier undefined; retaining dice with zero base is a delegated interpretation.
alternatives: Treat all Harpy Off-Duty as diceless
Invent a current PC Status modifier
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Actual ActorPlay uses one 2d6/base0/noHeat receipt and normal Tags; HarpyRest owns hide facts, original judge review, all-tier recovery and actual reviewed return independently of Cadre Period.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: No Cadre Period, Status, Permission, mission/reward or same-human sheet mutation.

campaign_rulings.summary: Owner may author any number of ordinary Identities, preserving actual protected retained Identities. Existing matching names retain stable IDs; new names get new IDs; explicit owner hide/adjustment confirmation clears marks. Transport/UI payload bounds do not become fictional four-Identity cap.
campaign_rulings.source: official private rulebook PDF179 / printed177; official private rulebook PDF181 / printed179
campaign_rulings.rationale: The Harpy rebirth text allows any number of new Identities and the Harpy Off-Duty text allows adjustment freely, while core Girl rules set a four-Identity cap. Applying the Harpy exception avoids silently deleting actual retained larger lists.
alternatives: Import basic Girl four-Identity cap
Retain current count only
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Source owner explicitly supplies ordinary names and confirms adjustment; protected retained IDs remain, matching names retain actual IDs and chosen marks clear. Existing Embrace threshold interaction remains identified for source clarity rather than automatic truncation.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Existing basic Embrace rule still replaces exactly one ordinary Identity at its printed threshold; never shrink an already larger Harpy list. Review existing len(all identities)>=4 threshold versus actual Free additional Identity as a distinct clarity item.

campaign_rulings.summary: The original human selected as scene Director may finish only already-owned procedural Tag/Dive/hide questions from the frozen original episode after actual Director death. Exact original cast/history/receipt and real ending proof required; living roles retain their own actual resources, otherwise original human marker is finite OOC plus/minus one without body/Bond authority.
campaign_rulings.source: official private rulebook PDF5 / printed3; official private rulebook PDF24 / printed22; official private rulebook PDF192 / printed190
campaign_rulings.rationale: Actual Director death changes future role authority but does not identify a new author for a human-owned question already created by a committed original episode. The book does not define pending-question reassignment.
alternatives: Transfer every pending answer to current campaign GM
Deadlock all already-owned questions
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: owned_director_procedure proves immutable original episode/cast/receipt, actual Director death and current same Harpy vessel; actual humans finish only finite owned procedures. Marker fallback is OOC plus/minus1/Bond0 and never a dead NPC body.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: No dead NPC mutation/revival, no new scene-role/global GM privilege. New episodes use actual current adjudicator.

campaign_rulings.summary: An exact original Harpy death closes her standing cut-link fight as original_died with actual ending event; it does not claim Helpless, healing, movement or successor compliance. Proposed original-owned hides/routes end sourcefully; existing offstage body/corpse position stays unknown.
campaign_rulings.rationale: A cut-link result requires fighting until Helpless; actual death makes that future body action impossible and is not itself the printed Helpless condition. Source closure must distinguish the two instead of forging compliance.
alternatives: Invent Helpless to satisfy fight condition
Keep an impossible dead-body fight pending forever
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Authoritative Harpy die records ended_event/original_died on exact standing fight; proposed hides/routes end with actual source, active offstage corpse location stays unknown. Actual already-damaged Girl Assets on unlink instead cause true source-foe Helpless.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Only impossible exact-original Off-Duty source choices close without human response; true final-act/death-Tag procedures remain owned.

campaign_rulings.summary: If factual killer is already an immutable ended original, record the chosen death Tag with stable ID and exact original recipient/giver in actual Harpy Defeat effect, leaving original archive snapshot immutable and replacement untouched. On a genuine same-original return, prove that actual recorded effect and materialize once with same stable ID.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The final Tag is inflicted on the actual killer, while a same-account replacement is a different character. Rewriting an immutable archive would falsify the earlier snapshot, and assigning to the successor would change the printed recipient.
alternatives: Grant Tag to current same-UID successor
Rewrite original archived sheet
Discard the printed final Tag
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: DefeatEffect is sole postcareer consequence with exact original recipient/giver and stable TagID; ended_actor_source proves real original ending. Actual original-return hook verifies immutable effect and materializes once; archive/new-body snapshots remain unchanged. Actual archived Handler no-inheritance and ordinary genuine-return regressions are covered; a full combined postcareer-Tag original-return scene is not separately exercised in current fixture.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: No extra live Tag pool; same-person late rebirth recipient handling remains separate and requires actual birth proof, never UID fallback.

campaign_rulings.summary: Knife removal records the actual patient-authored cut, body site and persistent wound with actual source event; it does not invent numeric Asset damage or another Handler Asset-replacement trigger.
campaign_rulings.rationale: The knife option describes actual removal but supplies no numerical damage cost or extra Handler Asset trigger. Inventing one could recurse into unrelated death/Asset replacement choices.
alternatives: Fabricate a numeric Handler Asset injury
Treat choosing the label as removal without actual performed account
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: HandlerVoid stores performed wound, localized site and removal event under actual patient audit; no Asset damage/HP, Pilot resources or movement changes.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Only actual source body/controller; no Pilot resources, transport or unrelated healing.

campaign_rulings.summary: Actual localized experimental-drug manifestation and halted spread satisfy the immediate printed choice while retaining void_present and an owned source treatment task. Subsequent actual removal remains necessary; no automatic execution or fictional timer is invented.

campaign_rulings.rationale: The printed drugs option halts spread; the subsequent note separately requires corruption removal or institutional consequences. The book gives no timer or automatic institution response, so immediate choice completion and persistent treatment must remain distinct.
alternatives: Pretend drugs removed all corruption
Hold unrelated completed interaction forever pending later surgery
Automatically execute the Handler
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Drugs creates real localized manifestation/spread_halted with void_present; source immediate work completes only after authenticated actual choice. Separate owned treatment remains visible even after source work resolves, with real later removal or actual original death.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Original source parent may proceed after actual stabilization; actual biological condition remains pending on same original body until real removal or death.

campaign_rulings.summary: Choosing surgery requests actual immediate treatment; completion requires actual original human factual attestation that personnel performed the procedure and removed corruption, with specific account. It grants no other healing, coordinates, transport or NPC dialogue.

alternatives: Auto-teleport to a medical bay and manufacture a surgeon response
Treat request alone as performed removal
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Surgery choice leaves Void present and original source held; actual original human later attests performed procedure and removal with account. Completion proves the actual surgical event; physical coordinates/resources are untouched.
campaign_rulings.change_impact: Source remains held until actual performed-procedure source, and no fake consent or fake human reply is emitted.

campaign_rulings.summary: Actual Director NPC uses normal Handler physiology with its own original body/controller, independently of main Handler. Main Handler in an actual Director Girl-rules context uses actual Girl Asset corruption, never the normal Handler option list.
campaign_rulings.source: official private rulebook PDF19 / printed17; official private rulebook PDF192 / printed190

Impersonate the main GM body when Director NPC gains Void

campaign_rulings.summary: Zero modeled mechanical Girl Assets require an actual owner proposal of real preexisting gear/cybernetics/capability plus original source GM/selected judge factual review. Preserve actual damage and weapon facts, cap at four, store one sole HeldItem Asset authority with immutable proposal/review proofs. No automatic baseline two, new gear, paid Ability, repair or Frame is granted.

alternatives: Invent two starting Assets
Treat zero Assets as all Void
Use normal Handler physiology despite Girl-rule context
campaign_rulings.implementation_note: Original patient proposes real existing capability/gear, frozen source judge factually reviews, cap4 is rechecked and actual existing damage/weapon status is preserved. HeldItem is sole mechanical authority; immutable proposal/review/origin proof is checked by Item.prove_item. Failed facts leave forced source pending, not cancelled.

campaign_rulings.summary: For Mockingbird high source, original caster chooses the actual existing counterpart Asset; affected Handler Girl writes its Void change. Factual registration owner/judge roles remain separate.
campaign_rulings.source: official private rulebook PDF19 / printed17; official private rulebook PDF36 / printed34; official private rulebook PDF192 / printed190
campaign_rulings.rationale: Mockingbird high explicitly gives the caster the Asset choice, while the general Void rule describes the affected person rewriting the change. Factual setup must not transfer the caster choice to patient or bot.
